name: Kamerton Bezmolvija
source:
Welcome to the Russian Twin Peaks. Here, among peeling Khrushchev-era buildings and majestic ancient pines, the teachings of Don Juan meet the aesthetics of Venedikt Erofeev. Instead of the promised enlightenment, there's a hangover and guilt.

Help Alex, a student and failed mystic, in his search for his beloved, who disappeared under mysterious circumstances. A journey through garages, liquor stores, and snow-covered cemeteries will lead him to eerie worlds inaccessible to mere mortals.
